plan:
Final design written to /workspace/final_design.md (30,631 bytes, 315 lines). Structure and contents:

(i) Executive summary with hypothesis and a falsifiable four-gate decision rule (whole-eval gate 1, conditional gate 2, |D_dis|≥50 power gate 3, leakage gate 4 from D8). Verdict mapping: YES only on all four gates; otherwise NO with WHOLE-EVAL-DID-NOT-CREDIT or CONDITIONAL-DID-NOT-CREDIT diagnostics; INCONCLUSIVE if |D_dis|<50; DESIGN VIOLATION if splits overlap.

(ii) Rationale linking A/B/C outline and D1–D8 defaults: A → primary metric layer joined to gate 1; B → frozen ChatGPT label-stream indexing D_dis per Q1 R-S; C → three-way y_gpt/y_human/y_adj fold per Q3 R-T with senior adjudicator as NEW role.

(iii) End-to-end design with iii.1 OP-A dataset binding (k=5, symmetric noise p=0.30, N=6k–10k, frozen-seed Gaussian mixture), iii.2 split discipline (D_train/D_raw_train/D_clean_train/D_gold/D_test disjoint per D8), iii.3 Docta D-mock committed as a *specific* algorithm = L2-multinomial-LR backbone h + bounded EM (max 3 iterations, ε=1e-3 Laplace, 0.5/0.5 old/new Q mixing, ‖ΔQ‖∞<1e-3 convergence) + Bayes posterior + argmax with smallest-index tie-break, logged as docta_mock_v1.confusion_matrix_aware.bounded_em.k5_lambda_freeze; iii.4 ChatGPT frozen at gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 with frozen 6-line prompt template, retry policy, and D-mock surrogate fallback; iii.5 human pipeline = ≥2 line annotators + committed y_human rule + senior adjudicator invoked twice (D6 tie-break and D_dis analysis fold) with full blinding log; iii.6 D_dis = {i: y_gpt[i]≠y_human[i] ∧ y_human[i]≠REQUIRES_REVIEW}, computed once, frozen.

(iv) Four named controls: SL-1 untouched D_dis replication slice (30% withheld); SL-2 adjudicator-vs-both sensitivity slice (reported, not in FWER family); SL-3 label-shuffled null (in FWER family, design-violating if M_shuf beats M_clean); SL-4 OP-B noise-rate sweep p∈{0.10,0.30,0.50} as out-of-scope extension. Plus a hidden fixed-seed determinism check.

(v) Pre-registered analysis: macro-F1 primary, accuracy + error rate secondary; paired permutation M=10,000 (k=5) / exact McNemar (binary) per D4; paired bootstrap B=2,000; four-gate Holm-Bonferroni at α_family=0.05, m=4; closed-form D5 power target — McNemar framing detects π_1≥0.69 at |D_dis|=50 with power 0.8; macro-F1 framing detects |Δ_dis|≈0.06 at σ̂_Δ≈0.15 marginal to δ_co=0.05 at exactly |D_dis|=50.

(vi) Feasibility: 24 CPUs / no GPU / Python 3.12.3 / no pip / network disabled; what runs offline (3–10 CPU-h headline, 9–30 with SL-4); what is mocked (D-mock Docta + ChatGPT D-mock surrogate, both disclosed in results headers); what is human-hours (line annotators ~5–15 h; senior adjudicator ~25 min to ~9 h, explicitly budgeted as the Q3 NEW-role line); explicit out-of-scope; runtime-fillables signposted.

(vii) Threats to validity: C1–C3 construct, I1–I5 internal, E1–E4 external, S1–S3 statistical; residual unknowns and the runtime-stage fill-ins listed.

No experiments executed. No network calls. No empirical numbers fabricated. Any numeric result in the document is explicitly labelled as a forecast, target, or runtime-fillable.

Files in /workspace after this turn:
- task.json (input, untouched)
- approach_lock.md (previous round, unchanged)
- final_design.md (this deliverable)

Waiting for researcher verdict.
